Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla): SFG ≤ 1,000 gauss/cm (10 T/m); slew rate ≤ 200 T/m/s per axis; at 1.5 T: B1+rms ≤ 2.4 microtesla; at 3 T: whole body SAR not to exceed 1.5 W/kg.
Device configuration during MRI: MRI mode ON.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
